notes.title: Soohee Pyeon's After Story DLC Release (3/30)
Soo-hee DLC 3/30 Release
notes.notes:
Thank you all for showing so much love for Some Some Convenience Store.

We would like to officially confirm that Soohee's DLC chapter will be released in Korean on March 30th!

The English language patch is scheduled to follow in April.

Thank you from everyone here at Tales~Shop!

notes.title: [Somesome Convenience Store Yena DLC] Release Postponed
notes.notes:
Due to the delay in the internal development schedule, it was inevitably postponed.
Sorry.
I'll make to a more fun game.

*. [Soohee DLC] will also be postponed for one month due to the postponement of the entire development schedule for Somesome.
(Released February 2021)

notes.title: English version update
notes.notes:
Hello TALESshop fans,

 

We've worked hard to prepare a big English version update for you all! 

 

We would like to start out by apologizing for the translation problems that some of you have pointed out in the review sections.

We've heard you and have spent the last 2 months completely reworking the English translation for Some Some Convenience Store!

 

Our next plan is to fix the errors in Adela's DLC and then all of our TALESshop games so that English language gamers can enjoy our visual novels to their fullest.

 

Thank you for your continued support!
